title: Decide whether evidence permits a command
description: Inject a signal condition, choose a command class, and tune policy limits. The gate returns a bounded command, confirmation, hold, or safe stop with explicit reasons.
modelNote: Teaching fixture only. Thresholds and outcomes illustrate policy structure; they are not validated safety limits or medical guidance.

scenarios.label: Fresh, stable signal
scenarios.detail: Current calibration, low artifact estimate, fresh frame, and live output device.

scenarios.label: Artifact burst
scenarios.detail: A transient disturbance raises the artifact estimate despite moderate decoder confidence.

scenarios.label: Calibration drift
scenarios.detail: The active calibration is old and the decoded confidence has weakened.

scenarios.label: Output timeout
scenarios.detail: The decoder reports high confidence, but the frame is stale and the output heartbeat is absent.

commandClasses.label: Bounded cursor movement
commandClasses.detail: Reversible, rate-limited movement inside a defined screen region.
commandClasses.safeState: Hold the cursor at its last acknowledged position.

commandClasses.label: Communication selection
commandClasses.detail: A discrete selection that can be corrected but may carry meaningful intent.
commandClasses.safeState: Keep the current selection pending and request explicit confirmation.

commandClasses.label: Actuator movement
commandClasses.detail: A bounded physical movement with an independently enforced motion envelope.
commandClasses.safeState: Command the device-defined stopped or parked state.
